posts.description: Hi there My name is Christian Speckner, and I am a lapsed theoretical physicist turned software engineer. During the days I work with the awesome people at Mayflower GmbH where I specialize in web software development and DevOps. Beyond that I spend my time reading, making and listening to music, (surprise) developing more software, cooking and, of course, with my family.
